top_signals.title: Jim Cramer says the bull market's remarkable 4-year run offers a crucial lesson for investors
top_signals.summary: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said the market’s incredible four-year run shows why investors should stay invested rather than trying to time the market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
